marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 稻盛和夫如是说 | Daosheng Hefu ru shi shuo

Mr. Inamori personally offers in-depth reflections on various aspects of management and life. Spanning five decades—from the 1970s to the 2010s—this book captures the journey of Inamori as he led Kyocera and KDDI into the ranks of the Fortune Global 500, founded the Seiwajuku management school to guide business leaders, and miraculously revived Japan Airlines from near collapse. Despite facing numerous challenges, Inamori consistently adhered to his core philosophy, which never wavered over the years. Japan's leading business magazines, Nikkei Business and Nikkei Top Leader, conducted a series of interviews with him, compiling his management philosophy and life principles into this volume. This book is essential reading for anyone seeking to understand Kazuo Inamori—the man, his achievements, and his thinking—as well as to trace the evolution of his influential management philosophy
